feasibility_flag.empirical_verification: 100.00% exact match across all 60,000 rows in dataset
feasibility_flag.physical_meaning: Maneuver is feasible if and only if required delta-v does not exceed maximum satellite delta-v capacity

time_to_TCA.empirical_verification: Decreases monotonically across timesteps per event, non-positive after TCA
time_to_TCA.physical_meaning: Time remaining to Time of Closest Approach; past TCA no collision avoidance maneuver can be executed

maneuver_window_remaining.empirical_verification: Tracks remaining execution window before TCA
maneuver_window_remaining.physical_meaning: Lead time required to plan and initiate thruster burn before TCA

deltav_required.physical_meaning: Impulsive delta-V required to achieve safe miss distance at TCA
deltav_required.provenance: Computed from relative geometry and orbital kinematics

max_delta_v.physical_meaning: Maximum available velocity change supported by remaining onboard propellant and propulsion subsystem
max_delta_v.provenance: Spacecraft subsystem specification and fuel status

fuel_margin.physical_meaning: Normalized fuel margin relative to maneuver requirements
fuel_margin.provenance: Derived from fuel remaining and delta-v capacity

poc.physical_meaning: Probability of Collision computed from conjunction covariance ellipsoids and hard body radius
poc.provenance: NASA / standard conjunction assessment collision probability formulation

cost_of_acting.physical_meaning: Expected operational and fuel cost of executing a collision avoidance maneuver
cost_of_acting.provenance: Derived in simulator as function of delta-v, fuel depletion, and operational disruption

cost_of_waiting.physical_meaning: Expected risk cost of deferring maneuver decision to future observations (risk evolution + uncertainty)
cost_of_waiting.provenance: Derived in simulator from PoC, uncertainty growth rate, and remaining maneuver window

commit_decision.type: Type C (Supervised Decision Label / Policy Target)
commit_decision.provenance: Supervised target generated in simulation balancing risk mitigation, feasibility shield, and cost trade-offs
commit_decision.causal_note: Observed decision target, NOT a randomized experimental treatment. Causal analysis must define structured interventions and SCM.
